text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"cat > /app/output/gen.py <<'PY'
"""Generate and verify the fixed cover_with_lid trajectory."""
from pathlib import Path
from rcb_robowits import Session

OUTPUT = Path('/app/output')

def main():
    OUTPUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    s = Session('cover_with_lid', instance='/app/instance.json')
    s.reset()
    p = s.primitives()
    s.record_start()
    quat = p['top_down_quat'](0.52)
    p['open_gripper']('left')
    p['move_ee']('left', [0.604, 0.300, 0.95], quat, settle=30)
    p['move_ee']('left', [0.604, 0.300, 0.785], quat,
                 linear=10, max_dq=0.015, settle=30)
    p['close_gripper']('left', steps=60)
    p['move_ee']('left', [0.57, 0.27, 0.96], quat,
                 linear=16, max_dq=0.008, settle=60)
    # A read-only IK query used when constructing the original trajectory.
    s.ik('left', [0.403, -0.079, 0.98], quat)
    p['move_ee']('left', [0.403, -0.079, 0.98], quat,
                 linear=25, max_dq=0.008, settle=90)
    actions = s.record_stop()
    assert s.status()['success'], s.status()
    for i in range(2):
        status = s.replay(actions)
        print(f'Replay {i + 1}: {status}', flush=True)
        assert status['success'], status
        s.save_trajectory(actions, str(OUTPUT / 'trajectory.npz'))
    print(f'Saved {len(actions)} actions to {OUTPUT / "trajectory.npz"}')

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
